short_summary: Cape Town CBD: added 5 new businesses on Long/Bree Street (Mama Africa, Royale Eatery, Clarke's Bar and Dining Room, Barr's Pharmacy, Clarke's Bookshop), all with verified phone numbers and addresses. Added Golden Acre shopping centre (9 Adderley Street) but deferred tenant discovery to job 3's official-site sweep, queued via shopping_center_slugs_pending. Discarded a gym lead (Zone Fitness/Virgin Active) where sources conflicted on which brand occupies the address.

Gardens: added 3 new businesses on Kloof Street/Queen Victoria Street (Kloof Street House, Our Local, Cape Town Hollow Boutique Hotel), all with verified phone numbers and addresses. Added Gardens Shopping Centre (cnr Mill and Buitenkant Streets) but deferred tenant discovery to job 3's official-site sweep. Discarded a dental-practice lead (Gardens Dental Surgery / The Dental Clinic) where only one source confirmed a phone number and the tenant name was ambiguous between similarly-named practices.

Tamboerskloof: added 3 new businesses (Cafe Puka, Dinkel Bakery, The Cape Milner hotel), all with verified phone numbers and addresses. No shopping centres found in this mostly-residential suburb. Noted a couple of near-miss leads that turned out to belong to neighbouring suburbs (Red Sofa Cafe is in Vredehoek, not Tamboerskloof) and left them for those suburbs' own future runs.

Checked the first 5 businesses alphabetically (barrs-pharmacy-cape-town-cbd through kloof-street-house-gardens, all published earlier this same run) -- all still open on current sources, none confirmed permanently closed. Note: Clarke's Bar and Dining Room had a temporary closure announced in 2024 but recent August 2026 reviews confirm it has reopened, so left untouched. closed_check_last_slug now 'kloof-street-house-gardens'.

Rewrote 10 descriptions (of 11 in the whole backlog) with genuine new facts found via research, covering Barr's Pharmacy, Cafe Puka, Cape Town Hollow Boutique Hotel, Clarke's Bar and Dining Room, Clarke's Bookshop, Dinkel Bakery, Kloof Street House, Mama Africa, Our Local and Royale Eatery. Added a new source for 9 of them; Kloof Street House's new facts came from a source already on file, so nothing new to append there. Trading hours found and recorded for 7 of the 10; skipped for Cape Town Hollow (hotel, no published trading hours) and for Dinkel Bakery and Kloof Street House (sources gave conflicting times).

Rewrote the last remaining backlog description, The Cape Milner (57-room boutique hotel, Art Deco/Victorian design, renovated 2014), added a new source. No trading hours applicable (hotel). Description-enrichment backlog is now fully cleared.

Golden Acre has a real official site (golden-acre.co.za/stores/) but it's blocked by this sandbox's egress proxy, and WebSearch snippets only surfaced roughly 40 of its ~105 stores -- not the complete directory, so no reconciliation was attempted (a partial list would risk wrongly unlinking real tenants). Also found the centre is mid-redevelopment (sold Feb 2025, construction from Oct 2025, completion ~Jan 2027) though shopper access is said to continue throughout. Removed from shopping_center_slugs_pending; will get its first re-check via the normal 30-run recheck rotation.

Oranjezicht: added Ou Meul Bakery (cnr Montrose & Upper Orange Street) and Molteno Road Dental Practice (12 Molteno Road), both with verified phone numbers and addresses. Discarded Will's Cafe-Deli (no phone number found in any source) and two guesthouses, Orange Guest House and Floreal House (phone numbers only appeared in unverifiable AI-summarised search results, not literally in any source snippet). Also found that the well-known 'Oranjezicht City Farm Market' actually operates from the V&A Waterfront, not Oranjezicht itself, despite the name -- left for that suburb's own future run. No shopping centres found in this mostly residential suburb.

Vredehoek: added Red Sofa Cafe (21 Derry Street), Deer Park Cafe (2 Deer Park Drive) and KwikSpar Vredehoek (37 Derry Street), all with verified phone numbers and addresses. Discarded a lead for Lazari cafe, where sources disagreed on whether it's actually in Vredehoek or in neighbouring Gardens -- left for whichever suburb's future run resolves the ambiguity. No shopping centres found in this suburb.

Zonnebloem: added Digitas Liquorice and Arc, two marketing/creative agencies both based at The Harrington, 50 Harrington Street. A mostly institutional/residential suburb with little else surfacing -- notably, several well-known 'Zonnebloem'-named schools (Zonnebloem Nest Senior School, Zonnebloem Boys/Girls Primary) turned out to have their actual addresses in neighbouring Walmer Estate, so were left for that suburb's own future run rather than published here. No shopping centres found.

Checked the next 5 businesses after 'kloof-street-house-gardens' (mama-africa-cape-town-cbd, our-local-gardens, royale-eatery-cape-town-cbd, the-cape-milner-tamboerskloof, wrapping to barrs-pharmacy-cape-town-cbd) -- all still open on current sources, none confirmed permanently closed. Noted Royale Eatery had a 2020 pandemic-era relocation to Claremont reported, but current sources (2026) describe an active Long Street listing with current hours, so left untouched absent an explicit closure tag. closed_check_last_slug now 'barrs-pharmacy-cape-town-cbd'.

Cleared the entire job-4 backlog: rewrote descriptions for Arc and Digitas Liquorice (both agencies at The Harrington, Zonnebloem), Deer Park Cafe and Red Sofa Cafe (Vredehoek), KwikSpar Vredehoek, Ou Meul Bakery (Oranjezicht) and Molteno Road Dental Practice (Oranjezicht). All 7 got genuine new facts via WebSearch (WebFetch still blocked for these domains) with a new source appended for KwikSpar, Molteno Road Dental Practice, Deer Park Cafe and Red Sofa Cafe. Trading hours recorded for 5 of the 7 (the two agencies have no public trading hours).

Gardens Shopping Centre has a real official site (gardensshoppingcentre.co.za) with its own store-directory page, but the domain is blocked by this sandbox's egress proxy, and WebSearch snippets only surfaced 3 of the centre's ~86 stores (PostNet, Cape Union Mart, Clicks) -- nowhere near a complete list, so no reconciliation was attempted. Removed from shopping_center_slugs_pending; will get its first re-check via the normal 30-run recheck rotation like Golden Acre.

Woodstock: added The Old Biscuit Mill and The Palms Decor and Lifestyle Centre (both queued for their first job-3 official-site sweep), plus 5 businesses -- The Potluck Club and Neighbourgoods Market (both tenants of the Old Biscuit Mill), Casa Woodstock Bar and District Cafe, and GoGo Woodstock. Discarded La Bottega (address only said 'Cape Town', not confirmed as Woodstock), Karoo Moon Country Store (three conflicting phone numbers across sources, couldn't confidently pin one), and several other Old Biscuit Mill boutique tenants for lack of a findable phone number -- left the mill's full tenant list for job 3's upcoming official-site sweep.

Observatory: discovered Riverlands Mall, a new riverside shopping centre at 51 Gogosoa St anchored by Checkers, Woolworths Food and Clicks (queued for its first job-3 official-site sweep), and added 3 of its tenants -- Clicks Riverlands Mall, Barksole (pet store) and Sorbet Salon -- plus 2 standalone Lower Main Road cafes, Cocoa Cha Chi and Mimi's. Discarded OBZ Cafe (three different, conflicting phone numbers across sources -- couldn't confidently pin one to this location) and The Image & Hair salon (address and phone got mixed up with a different Lower Main Road business across sources).

Salt River: added Dimensions Tent & Structures and Artappel Prop Hire (both in the Transnet/Voortrekker Road industrial cluster), Cape of Storms Distilling Company (a craft rum distillery in The Spice Yard) and BUCO Salt River (hardware store on Brickfield Road), all with verified phone numbers and addresses. Discarded Transnet Engineering's head office (three conflicting phone numbers across sources for what should be one main line), Salt River Pharmacy (two different addresses given across sources), and the Freestyle and Zara factory shops (no phone number found for either). Also noted Salt Circle Arcade at 374 Albert Road as a real multi-tenant arcade, but most sources place it in neighbouring Woodstock rather than Salt River -- left it out of this suburb's batch pending clearer suburb attribution on a future run.

Checked the 5 businesses after 'barrs-pharmacy-cape-town-cbd' (cafe-puka-tamboerskloof, cape-town-hollow-boutique-hotel-gardens, clarkes-bar-dining-room-cape-town-cbd, clarkes-bookshop-cape-town-cbd, deer-park-cafe-vredehoek) -- none confirmed permanently closed. Clarke's Bar and Dining Room had news of a 2020/2024 temporary closure amid tough trading conditions, but no explicit current 'permanently closed' status was found, so left untouched. closed_check_last_slug now 'deer-park-cafe-vredehoek'.

Rewrote 10 descriptions -- 7 with new facts found via research (Artappel Prop Hire, Barksole Riverlands, Cape of Storms Distilling Company, Casa Woodstock Bar, Cocoa Cha Chi, Dimensions Tent & Structures, GoGo Woodstock), 3 reworded from existing category/suburb data only (BUCO Salt River, Clicks Riverlands, District Cafe). Trading hours found and recorded for 5 of the 10.

Rewrote 4 descriptions -- 3 with new facts found via research (Mimi's, Neighbourgoods Market, Sorbet Salon Riverlands), 1 reworded from existing category/suburb data only (The Potluck Club). No new trading hours found for this batch (sources disagreed or gave only partial hours). Job 4 backlog now clear.

The Old Biscuit Mill has an official site (theoldbiscuitmill.co.za) but this sandbox's egress proxy blocks WebFetch to it, and WebSearch snippets only surfaced a partial tenant sample (each explicitly noting it wasn't the full directory) -- not enough to confidently reconcile links/unlinks, so treated as no official site per the routine's fallback rule and skipped rather than risk unlinking real tenants off a partial list. Removed from pending queue; now part of the ordinary recheck rotation.

Bo-Kaap: added 6 new businesses (all with verified phone numbers and addresses) -- Bo-Kaap Kombuis, Bo-Kaap Deli and Biesmiellah (Cape Malay restaurants), Lion's Bread (bakery), Bo-Kaap Museum (heritage museum), and Atlas Trading Company (historic spice shop).

De Waterkant: added 3 new businesses (Riva Italian fish restaurant, Ground Art Caffe, Lume Beauty Atelier), added Cape Quarter Lifestyle Village shopping centre (tenant directory not accessible this run -- WebFetch blocked to capequarter.co.za -- queued for job 3's first sweep).
Devil's Peak Estate: no businesses found -- confirmed via multiple searches this is a small, purely residential sub-suburb of Vredehoek with no commercial premises; nothing to publish.

Checked 5 businesses starting after 'deer-park-cafe-vredehoek' (Digitas Liquorice, Dimensions Tent & Structures, Dinkel Bakery, District Cafe, GoGo Woodstock) -- no confirmed permanent closures found for any, all still open. closed_check_last_slug now 'gogo-woodstock-woodstock'.

Cleared the full description-enrichment backlog (9 businesses across Bo-Kaap and De Waterkant): Atlas Trading Company, Biesmiellah, Bo-Kaap Deli, Bo-Kaap Kombuis, Bo-Kaap Museum, Ground Art Caffe, Lion's Bread, Lume Beauty Atelier, Riva -- all rewritten with genuine researched facts (history, specialties, ownership character) via WebSearch snippets (WebFetch still blocked). Trading hours found and recorded for 7 of the 9; added a new source for Atlas Trading Company and Ground Art Caffe.

The Palms Decor and Lifestyle Centre has an official site (palms.co.za) with its own tenants page, but this sandbox's egress proxy blocks WebFetch to it, and separate WebSearch snippets returned two non-overlapping partial tenant fragments (clearly not the full directory) -- not enough to confidently reconcile links/unlinks, so treated as no official site per the routine's fallback rule and skipped rather than risk unlinking real tenants off a partial list. Removed from pending queue; now part of the ordinary recheck rotation.

District Six: no businesses found -- confirmed via multiple searches that most of the historical area remains vacant land under a slow land-restitution redevelopment (the suburb name was only restored in 2019 after decades as 'Zonnebloem'), and present-day commercial addresses commonly associated with the area (District Six Museum, Belly of the Beast on Harrington Street) are themselves addressed in the neighbouring Zonnebloem suburb, not District Six itself -- nothing to publish under this suburb slug.

Higgovale: added 2 new businesses, both boutique guesthouses (Rosedene Guest House, Kensington Place), each verified with matching name, address and phone across independent sources. Discarded Villa Zeezicht, Ashanti Guesthouse and Jardin d'Ebene as actually addressed in neighbouring Gardens/Tamboerskloof, and De Tafelberg Guesthouse for conflicting Higgovale/Oranjezicht address claims across sources.

University Estate: confirmed via multiple sources this is a suburb zoned almost exclusively for residential use, with only a small industrial/office complex at 96 Upper Roodebloem Road (Oasis Park) as a commercial exception. Discarded that one as unverifiable -- sources disagree on whether the building is University Estate or the neighbouring Walmer Estate, and no specific retail tenant could be confirmed there beyond a vague, unconfirmed mention. Nothing to publish this run.

Checked 5 businesses starting after 'gogo-woodstock-woodstock' (Ground Art Caffe, Kloof Street House, KwikSpar Vredehoek, Lion's Bread, Lume Beauty Atelier) -- no confirmed permanent closures found with confidence; Ground Art Caffe and Lume Beauty Atelier turned up ambiguous/conflicting directory signals (an old Uber Eats delisting, a stale 'marked as closed' aggregator flag) but no literal, current 'Permanently closed' tag matching this exact location, so left untouched per the routine's conservative rule. closed_check_last_slug now 'lume-beauty-atelier-de-waterkant'.

Rewrote descriptions for the 2 remaining backlog businesses (both Higgovale guesthouses) -- Kensington Place and Rosedene Guest House, each with genuine new facts (room counts, amenities, views) found via research and a new corroborating source appended. No trading hours found for either (accommodation businesses don't publish shop-style hours). Job 4 backlog now empty.

Riverlands Mall: found a real official site (riverlands.capetown) advertising 40+ tenants across a paginated mall directory, but the domain is blocked for WebFetch and WebSearch snippets only surfaced a handful of names (Checkers, Woolworths, Clicks, Chops Biltong, ELARI, Barksole) with no way to confirm the complete list -- per the routine, a partial list is worse than none, so treated as no confirmed directory available and skipped reconciliation this run. Removed from pending queue; joins the ordinary recheck rotation.

V&A Waterfront: added Victoria Wharf Shopping Centre (3 Dock Rd), the precinct's main retail complex, confirmed via its own official site (waterfront.co.za) and a second independent source. Deferred tenant discovery to job 3's official-site sweep (queued via shopping_center_slugs_pending) rather than attempting a partial pass on a mall this large.

Walmer Estate: added Walmer Estate Primary School (Cambridge Street), confirmed via multiple independent school-directory sources agreeing on address and phone. Discarded Walmerhood Takeaways (sources disagreed on street address -- 110 Upper Queens Rd vs 61 Upper Coventry Rd) and Walmer Butchery/Abassies (conflicting business identity and a one-digit phone number discrepancy across sources).

Sea Point: added Stud. The Burger Shop and Goldies Deli, both on Main Road with verified phone numbers and addresses across multiple sources (Goldies' address confirmed as 176 Main Road after resolving a 174/176 discrepancy -- the business relocated next door). Added The Point shopping centre (76 Regent Road), a ~24-store retail complex confirmed via two independent sources; deferred its tenant sweep to job 3.

Checked 5 businesses starting after 'lume-beauty-atelier-de-waterkant' (Mama Africa, Mimi's, Molteno Road Dental Practice, Neighbourgoods Market, Ou Meul Bakery) -- no confirmed permanent closures. Mama Africa and Molteno Road Dental Practice each had one stale/conflicting directory listing showing 'closed' but current sources (official sites, recent reviews) confirm both are operating; Mimi's has an ambiguous 'Removed' aggregator flag but no literal Permanently Closed Google Maps tag, so left untouched per the routine's conservative rule. closed_check_last_slug now 'ou-meul-bakery-oranjezicht'.

Enriched all 3 backlogged descriptions: Goldies Deli (kosher deli, operating since 1992, hours found) and Stud. The Burger Shop (Western Cape burger chain, hours found) both got new researched facts and sources; Walmer Estate Primary School reworded with enrollment/staffing facts found via a school directory (no trading hours applicable to a school).

Cape Quarter Lifestyle Village has a real official site (capequarter.co.za/shops/) but it's on the blocked-domain list for this sandbox, and WebSearch snippets only surfaced a partial sample of its ~59-outlet directory (roughly a dozen named stores across categories), not the complete list -- per the routine's rule, an unconfirmed partial list is treated the same as no official site found, so no reconciliation was done this run. Removed from the pending queue; will re-enter the normal recheck rotation.

Green Point: added Tiger's Milk (Main Road), Giovanni's Deliworld (Italian deli/grocery, trading since 1989) and Il Leone Mastrantonio (Italian restaurant, Cobern Street), all with phone numbers and addresses confirmed across multiple independent sources. Discarded Randy Warthog Bar & Grill (only a phone number for the co-located never@home hostel was found, not confirmed as the bar's own) and a vaguely-referenced 'Green Point Shopping Centre' (no confirmable address or distinct official site, likely not a real multi-tenant centre).

Mouille Point: added Lily's, Cafe Neo and Newport Market & Deli (all on the Beach Road strip), The Greek Club Restaurant (Bay Road), and Sotano (seafood, Beach Road), all with phone numbers and addresses confirmed across multiple independent sources. Discarded Theo's Grill -- multiple sources confirm it was replaced by a Hussar Grill branch at that address, so the listing no longer applies.

Bantry Bay: added The President Hotel (Alexander Road) and The Bantry Aparthotel (Alexander Road), both hotels with confirmed phone numbers and addresses -- a thin result reflecting this suburb's largely residential/apartment character. Discarded Zest Restaurant (cross-checked sources show it's actually in Sea Point, not Bantry Bay) and the President Hotel's in-house restaurants/spa (no independent phone number found for any of them, distinct from the hotel's own).

Checked 5 businesses starting after 'ou-meul-bakery-oranjezicht' (Our Local, Red Sofa Cafe, Riva, Rosedene Guest House, Royale Eatery) -- confirmed Royale Eatery's Long Street location permanently closed (multiple sources: it shut in the 2020 COVID lockdown and the business relocated to Claremont under new management; RestaurantGuru also lists the Long Street listing as Closed). The other 4 still show current operating information across multiple sources. closed_check_last_slug now 'royale-eatery-cape-town-cbd'.

Job 4 checkpoint 1/2 of this run's batch -- enriched 10 businesses (Ackermans Golden Acre, Addis in Cape, Advanced Electric Fencing, Affordable Office Factory Shop, Amare, Artvark Gallery, Authentic Aesthetics S.A, BP Southfield, Bailey Haynes Inc, Banana Jam Cafe). 8 got genuine new researched facts (new sources appended for Addis in Cape, Affordable Office Factory Shop, Amare, Artvark Gallery, Authentic Aesthetics S.A, Bailey Haynes Inc, Banana Jam Cafe), 2 reworded from existing fields only (Advanced Electric Fencing, BP Southfield had only directory-listing sources with no distinguishing facts beyond category). Trading hours found and recorded for 7 of the 10.

Job 4 checkpoint 2/2 of this run's batch -- enriched 10 businesses (Belthazar, Bertha's Restaurant, Blackburns Pharmacy, Bootlegger Coffee Company x3 branches -- Bakoven, Cape Quarter, Dean Street Newlands -- Broadway Confectionery & Bakery, Buitenverwachting, Cafe Extrablatt, Cafe Caprice). 8 got genuine new researched facts with new sources appended (chain-page/official-site sources for the three Bootlegger branches, Broadway's own site, Buitenverwachting's history and tasting details, magazine features for Extrablatt and Caprice); Bertha's Restaurant and Blackburns Pharmacy reworded from existing fields only (no distinguishing facts beyond directory listings; Bertha's had conflicting hours across sources so hours left unset). Trading hours found and recorded for 9 of the 10. This closes out the run's ~20-business job-4 target; job 4 backlog now 104.

Victoria Wharf Shopping Centre's official site is waterfront.co.za (V&A Waterfront), but the domain is blocked for WebFetch in this sandbox and its store directory (450+ retail outlets across two levels, per its own PDF directories also hosted on the blocked domain) is far too large for WebSearch snippets to confirm completely -- per the routine's rule, an unconfirmed partial list is worse than none, so no reconciliation was attempted this run. Also noticed while investigating: the snapshot appears to carry a duplicate shopping-centre row for this same mall under two slugs (victoria-wharf-shopping-centre-va-waterfront, added this run, and an older victoria-wharf-va-waterfront with a different address string) with tenants split across both -- flagging for a human to merge/dedupe since that's outside this job's narrow scope. Removed from pending queue; now part of the ordinary recheck rotation.

Clifton: The Bungalow and Glen Country Club were already in the dataset from earlier research. The only other candidate found, Eatery Clifton (a shipping-container coffee spot at 51 Victoria Road), had no findable phone number across sources, so discarded per the phone-and-address rule. Nothing new to publish this run.

Camps Bay: discovered The Promenade shopping centre (87 Victoria Road, confirmed via its own site promenadecampsbay.com and a commercial-property listing) and added 5 verified tenants inside it -- Bilboa, Zenzero, Paranga, The Raj and Hard Rock Cafe Cape Town -- plus 3 standalone Victoria Road businesses found via general search: The 41, Tiger's Milk (Camps Bay branch, distinct address from the existing Green Point and Century City branches) and Kauai (at the separate Isaacs Corner building, not inside The Promenade despite one source associating it with the centre). Deferred full reconciliation of The Promenade's remaining ~20+ tenants to job 3 (queued via shopping_center_slugs_pending) since WebFetch is blocked for its domain and only a handful of names surfaced in search snippets. Discarded Eatery Clifton (already logged under Clifton), Faithful to Nature, Wine Concepts and Wellness Warehouse -- all missing a confirmable phone number for this specific location.

Fresnaye: confirmed via multiple sources this is a primarily residential Atlantic Seaboard suburb with commercial activity concentrated in neighbouring Sea Point and the V&A Waterfront. The Clarendon Boutique Hotel (already in the dataset) is the one confirmed commercial premises actually addressed in Fresnaye itself; no other candidates turned up. Nothing new to publish this run.

closed_check_last_slug ('royale-eatery-cape-town-cbd') was no longer in the snapshot (it was the business closed last run, now excluded), so restarted from the beginning of the alphabetical list: checked Ackermans Golden Acre, Addis in Cape, Advanced Electric Fencing, Affordable Office Factory Shop and Amare. No confirmed permanent closures -- Addis in Cape and Amare have recent, actively-updated coverage confirming they're operating; Advanced Electric Fencing showed an ambiguous 'Closed now' status on one directory (a time-of-day indicator, not a literal Permanently Closed Google Maps tag) so left untouched per the routine's conservative rule; Ackermans and Affordable Office Factory Shop show current, consistent operating information. closed_check_last_slug now 'amare-bantry-bay'.

Rewrote 10 descriptions (batch 1/2) -- 4 with new facts found via research and a new source each (Abode's design story and materials, Absolute Pets Gardens' hours page, Addicted's product lines, African Elite's apartment offering), 6 reworded from existing chain/category data only (ABSA, the other three Absolute Pets branches, Ackermans Vangate, Andalousse). Trading hours found and recorded for 5 of the 10 (ABSA, Absolute Pets Point/Gardens branches, Ackermans Vangate, Andalousse).

Rewrote 10 descriptions (batch 2/2) -- 6 with new facts and a new source each (Apnisleep's oral-appliance treatment approach, Artformes' 2021 founding and sculpture/ceramics focus, Asian Mart's product range, AuTerra's 2011 founding and Fairmined-gold craft, BASI Pilates' booking policy, BUC Fitness Club's boutique-gym positioning), 4 reworded from existing chain/category data only (Atlantic Meat, BOA Beauty Bar, Baraka Gifts & Decor, Bare Laser Hair Removal). Trading hours found and recorded for 4 of the 10 (Atlantic Meat, AuTerra, BOA Beauty Bar, BUC Fitness Club). This completes this run's 20-business job-4 batch.

The Point has a real official site (thepointmall.co.za, confirmed via search) but its domain is blocked by this sandbox's egress proxy, and WebSearch snippets only surfaced a partial merchant list (roughly 20 names across its Essentials/Business/Lifestyle/Wellness/Active/Taste categories, out of what look like several dozen total). Per the routine's rule, a partial unconfirmed list is treated the same as no official site found -- no reconciliation attempted this run (no unlinks, no new links, no new tenants added) to avoid wrongly unlinking real tenants based on incomplete coverage. Removed from shopping_center_slugs_pending; will get its first re-check via the normal recheck rotation.

Three Anchor Bay: added Step Brothers Restaurant & Bar (6 Bill Peters Drive), Shift Espresso Bar (229 Main Road, Glengariff building) and The Eatery at Antrim House (23 Antrim Road), all with verified phone numbers and addresses. Discarded a lead for Andy's Sushi Bar -- sources place it at 315 Main Road, which is actually in neighbouring Sea Point, not Three Anchor Bay. No shopping centres found in this small, mostly residential coastal suburb.

Bakoven: confirmed via multiple sources this is a small, elite, purely residential area adjacent to Camps Bay with no shops of its own -- residents rely on the Camps Bay strip (Woolworths, Pick n Pay, The Promenade) and the V&A Waterfront for shopping. Bootlegger Coffee Company, already in the dataset under this suburb, remains the one confirmed commercial premises actually in Bakoven. Nothing new to publish this run.

Rondebosch: worked the missing set of Rondebosch Main Centre's own store directory against the 4 tenants already in the dataset -- added 6 confirmed tenants (Peacock Tea & Coffee, Sorbet Salon, Nando's, Pick n Pay, Zone Fitness, School and Leisure), each with a verified phone number and shop address, all linked to the existing shopping_center_id. Also discovered Riverside Mall (Cnr Belmont & Main Roads), a distinct, separately-managed centre from Rondebosch Main Centre despite being on the same road -- added it (verified via its own official site plus an aggregator) but deferred tenant discovery to job 3 since only generic anchor-tenant categories (not individual verifiable names) surfaced in search snippets. Note for a future job-3 sweep: the existing row 'mr-k-rondebosch' cites Riverside Mall in its address text but was originally sourced from Rondebosch Main Centre's own directory -- worth reconciling against both centres' official sites rather than assumed here.
